Files and folders in the person's Dropbox.

## Connect accounts

Each person connects their own Dropbox account in the Gateway, once, and every app that asks uses it. Apps never see the tokens. [How connecting works](/docs/connect-oauth)

The redirect URI to register, with your Gateway's address (like `apps.example.com`):

```text
https://<your gateway>/connect/dropbox/callback
```

Dropbox's API is POST throughout: a read set unlocks its listed read calls, anything else needs access: "write". `token_access_type=offline` is what yields a refresh token.

1. Open [dropbox.com](https://www.dropbox.com/developers/apps) and create an OAuth app (also called a client or an integration).
2. Add the redirect URI above.
3. Copy the client ID and client secret. The secret is often shown only once.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the client ID and secret:

```bash
everyapp provider add dropbox
```

Or add it in **Manage workspace → Providers**.

### Use it in an app

```ts
capabilities: {
  dropbox: { access: "read", scopes: ["files.read"], why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

Apps ask for these scope sets:

| Set | Allows | Provider scopes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `identity` | Dropbox account (who you are) | `account_info.read` |
| `files.read` | Files and folders (read) | `files.metadata.read`, `files.content.read` |
| `files.write` | Files and folders (read and write) | `files.metadata.read`, `files.content.read`, `files.metadata.write`, `files.content.write` |

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show dropbox` shows the client as set. Then open the account menu → **Connected accounts** → **Connect Dropbox**.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Dropbox).
